== != > >= < <= in contains like ilike；未: == != > >= < <= in contains like ilike; unknown operators are treated as ==
enum 列的取值范围，实现可落成 CHECK 之类的约束: The value range of an enum column; implementations may enforce it as a CHECK-like constraint
一行就是「列名 → 值」，键与类型由这张表的列声明决定，没有可声明的统一结构: A row is "column name → value"; the keys and types are determined by this table's column declarations, so there is no fixed schema to declare
为真时不建这一列: When true, this column is not created
任一列的值包含它即命中: Matches if any column's value contains it
值的类型随该列的 type 而变，运行期才确定: The value's type varies with the column's type and is only determined at runtime
列名 → 值，键与类型由这张表的列声明决定: Column name → value; the keys and types are determined by this table's column declarations
各家自己的说法，由平台翻成逻辑类型: Each database has its own name for this; the platform translates it into a logical type
多于一列即联合索引，顺序有意义: More than one column makes it a composite index; order matters
实现可落成列注释: Implementations may store it as a column comment
把外部 MySQL 表接入为平台的「数据表」资源，语义与托管表一致。: Connect an external MySQL table as the platform's "data table" resource, with the same semantics as a managed table.
插入时取当前时间: Takes the current time on insert
用这条凭证真连一次外接库并执行一次查询，返回上游原话: Actually connects to the external database with this credential and runs one query, returning the upstream response verbatim
留空 = 按主键（稳定序，分页才不跳行）: Leave empty to sort by primary key (a stable order, so pagination does not skip rows)
类型随列而变；in 的值是数组: The type varies with the column; for in, the value is an array
要不要命中总数：它往往比取一页贵得多: Whether to also compute the total count — it is often far more expensive than fetching one page
要几行；<=0 表示一行都不要（配合 with_total 就是只数个数）: How many rows to return; <=0 means return none (combined with with_total, this just counts rows)
